title: Using Language to Extend to Unseen Domains

layout.note: Three titled columns side by side, separated by thin dotted vertical rules: a yellow tile of photos with a stick figure and speech bubble below, a 2-D embedding sketch with dashed domain boxes and thumbnails under a long title, and a 2 x 2 photo grid with a caption.

lesson: Tell the story in three titled columns (what you have, what the method does, what you get) and keep one colour for the seen and one for the unseen domain through every column; in the middle, put photo thumbnails on two named similarity axes so an embedding shift reads as a move across a plane.
